## A cell with no figure

```{r}
#| classes: wrap-right
1 + 1
```

![A figure with no wrap class.](plot.png){#fig-plain width="50%"}

The figure above keeps its normal layout. See @fig-plain.

## A cell with a table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cars
#| tbl-cap: "A table from a cell with a wrap class."
#| classes: wrap-right
knitr::kable(head(cars, 3))
```

![A figure after the table cell, with no wrap class.](plot.png){#fig-after-table width="50%"}

The figure above keeps its normal layout. See @fig-after-table and @tbl-cars.

## A cell figure with no wrap class

```{r}
#| label: fig-unwrapped-cell
#| fig-cap: "A cell figure with no wrap class."
#| out-width: "30%"
plot(1:10)
```

The figure above keeps its normal layout and its 30% width. See @fig-unwrapped-cell.

## Raw HTML that is more than a comment

![A figure with raw HTML after its paragraph.](plot.png){#fig-raw .wrap-right width="30%"}

A short paragraph beside the figure. See @fig-raw.

```{=html}
<!-- a --><div class="raw-block">A raw block between comments.</div><!-- b -->
```

The raw block above ends the wrap, so it and this paragraph start below the figure.
